title: SR GT 200 Sport (Adventure Spec)
description: Representing Aprilia's prowess in the Urban Adventure Scooter class, the Aprilia SR GT 200 Sport (Adventure Spec) is delivers all-weather long-haul versatility with long-travel suspension compliance. A 200cc powerplant pumps out 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
